credits.changes: Local B05–B20 adaptation, schematic additions, separation and paint shading; B21 continuous solid roof, fitted windscreen junction and illustrative underside protections; B22 removes rejected external underside plates; original hull surface retained with procedural estimated finish, no extrusion; B23 roof edge heights matched to existing rails and two internal estimated carpeted cargo wheel-house covers

limitations: Schematic mechanical components; no repair procedure or mechanical simulation
Estimated dimensions and colours; seat profiles and fine trim not certified faithful
No cables, cooling circuits or complete internal construction
B22 underside finish and shallow visual ribs are procedural estimates on the original hull surface; no photograph or measured factory geometry used
B23 cargo trim is schematic; roof edge follows existing model rails, not a dimensional survey
